system.description:
The work songs and storm calls of Opal's docks and merchant fleets, the music that keeps a crew rowing when the wind dies, drawn from every culture that passes through its harbours.

  • Sea Shanty: aboard a ship or boat, or in any harsh environment (storms, desert marches, long exposure), your Exalt also gives every ally within 60ft Advantage on saves against fear and exhaustion.
    • 9th level: it reaches every ally within 120ft.
  • Maritime Voice: Advantage on Seamanship checks, and on Charisma checks with sailors, pirates, dock workers and maritime merchants.
